dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Stage 7 gave you the table. Today is only the part players still get wrong at the table: turning a faan count into the exact number that changes hands.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: One rule drives all of it. A discarder pays the full listed amount; on a self-draw each of the other three pays half, so the winner collects one and a half times the listed amount.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: So 8 faan is 64 from one player, but 32 from each of three players, 96 in total?

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Correct. And 10 faan is the ceiling, so anything above it still settles at 128 from a discarder or 192 from a self-draw.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: No definitions in this lesson, just numbers. Ready?

questions.question: Your hand is 3 faan: All Chows 平糊, Concealed Hand 門前清, and you win by self-draw. What does each opponent pay, and what do you collect in total?
questions.explanation: 3 faan is 8 on a discard, so a self-draw is half of that: 4 from each of three players, 12 in total.

questions.question: A 6-faan hand can be won either on a discard or by self-draw. How much more do you collect by self-drawing?
options: Nothing more, the two pay the same
questions.explanation: 6 faan pays 32 from a discarder, while a self-draw takes 16 from each of three players, 48 in total: 48 minus 32 is 16.

questions.question: You win a 9-faan hand on a discard. How many points does the discarder hand over?
questions.explanation: 9 faan sits at 96 on the table, and the discarder pays that whole amount alone while the other two pay nothing.

questions.question: Match each faan total to what a self-draw actually collects in total.
questions.explanation: A self-draw collects half the discard figure from each of three players: 8 times 3, 12 times 3, 24 times 3 and 48 times 3.

questions.question: Which of these payment statements are correct? (Select all that apply)
options: A 7-faan self-draw takes 24 from each opponent
Moving from 9 faan to 10 faan adds 32 to the discard payment
questions.explanation: A 10-faan self-draw is 64 from each of three players, 192 in total, not 128; the other three statements match the table exactly.

questions.question: Three opponents each pay you 48. What was your hand worth, and what would a discarder have paid instead?
questions.explanation: 48 each is half of 96, and 96 is the 9-faan line, so the discarder at 9 faan pays that same 96 in full.

questions.question: Your hand adds up to 12 faan: Full Flush 清一色 (7), All Pongs 對對糊 (3), self-draw (1) and Concealed Hand 門前清 (1). You win on a discard. What does the discarder pay?
options: 128, because the hand is capped at 10 faan
192, because 12 faan is paid in full
96, because the extra faan are halved
144, because 12 faan lands on the 9-faan line
questions.explanation: The table stops at 10 faan, so the two extra faan are ignored and 10 faan pays the discarder's figure of 128.

questions.question: A limit hand 例牌 is always counted as 10 faan. If you self-draw one, how many points do you collect in total?
questions.explanation: A 10-faan self-draw is 64 from each of three players, 192 in total, which is the largest single hand on the table.

14-7.title: How Many Faan?
14-7.subtitle: Put the whole chart to work

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Now the real thing. I describe a hand, you total the faan, then you price it. Two steps, every single time.

dialogues.speaker: you
dialogues.text: And I have to notice whether it was a discard or a self-draw, because that changes who pays.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: Right. Watch for three traps: a 包 liability that puts the whole bill on one player, the 10-faan ceiling, and bonuses that refuse to stack.

dialogues.speaker: mj
dialogues.text: If your total runs past 10, stop counting at 10 and price it there.

questions.question: You self-draw with All Chows 平糊, a fully concealed hand and no flowers at all. Total the faan, then price it.
options: 4 faan; 8 from each opponent, 24 in total
3 faan; 4 from each opponent, 12 in total
4 faan; 16 from each opponent, 48 in total
questions.explanation: 平糊 1 + 門前清 1 + 無花 1 + 自摸 1 = 4 faan, and a 4-faan self-draw is 8 from each of three players, 24 in total.

questions.question: Your hand is Mixed One Suit 混一色 (3) + All Pongs 對對糊 (3) + self-draw (1) + one seat flower 正花 (1). How many faan is that in total?
questions.explanation: 3 + 3 + 1 + 1 = 8 faan, which pays 64 from a discarder or 32 from each player on a self-draw.

questions.question: You win on a discard with Big Three Dragons 大三元: three dragon triplets, one chow and a pair, and you never claimed anything. Total the faan and the payment.
questions.explanation: The 5-faan pattern plus its three dragon triplets is 8, and Concealed Hand adds 1 more: 9 faan pays 96 from the discarder.

questions.question: Match each described hand to its total faan.

pairs.left: Mixed One Suit + All Pongs + self-draw
Big Three Dragons with three dragon triplets, on a discard

questions.explanation: The four totals are 1+1+1, 3+3+1, 7+1+1 and 5+3, giving 3, 7, 9 and 8.

questions.question: Which of these hands reach the 10-faan ceiling? (Select all that apply)
options: Full Flush 清一色 (7) + All Pongs 對對糊 (3)
Mixed One Suit 混一色 (3) + All Pongs (3) + self-draw (1) + Concealed Hand (1)
Big Flower Hand 大花糊 with a self-draw
questions.explanation: 清一色 7 + 對對糊 3 reaches 10 and both limit hands are 10 by definition, while the mixed hand only totals 8.

questions.question: You completed Big Three Dragons 大三元 by claiming West's discard of the third dragon triplet, so West is liable under 大三元包. You later self-draw the hand at 8 faan. How is the money paid?
options: West pays the whole self-draw alone: 96 points
West pays 64 and the other two pay 16 each
questions.explanation: Under 包 the liable player covers the entire self-draw, and 8 faan self-draw is 32 from each of three players, 96 in total, all of it from West.

questions.question: West's discard completed your third dragon triplet and made West liable for your whole self-draw. Your exposed melds are {{red}}{{red}}{{red}} and {{green}}{{green}}{{green}}. Which tile did West supply?
questions.explanation: The third dragon triplet is 白板, which turns the hand into 大三元: 5 faan plus 3 for the dragon triplets is 8, and West pays the entire 96-point self-draw alone.

questions.question: You self-draw a hand that adds up to 13 faan. How many points do you collect in total?
questions.explanation: 13 faan is over the ceiling, so it is priced as 10 faan: 64 from each of three players, 192 in total.
